Let me tell you what: you drop everything your doing, don't worry about the crazy amount of pain your in or todo list and you get up and go to that movie! It's time alike this that I know everything is going to turn out already

Here’s a polished, heartfelt version in your voice, ready to post:

---

I got a text today that said,  
“Mom, do you want to go to the movie with me?”

Let me tell you something.  
You drop *everything*.

You do not worry about the crazy amount of pain you’re in.  
You do not look at the to do list.  
You do not say maybe later.

You get up. You go. You sit next to your 18 year old who still wants to spend time with you.

Because these moments are sacred.  
Because this season is fleeting.  
Because no accomplishment, no email, no task will ever matter more than being chosen by your child.

It’s in moments like this that I feel it deep in my soul.  
Everything is going to turn out exactly how it’s supposed to.

God’s got us. 💛
